description: This file implements a gRPC server handler for Kuksa-Viss, including methods for authorization, data retrieval, setting values, and managing subscriptions, with support for SSL configuration.

classes.name: RequestServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements the gRPC service interface for Kuksa-Viss, handling authorization, get/set requests, and subscription management.

methods.name: authorizeHelper
methods.description: Handles session authorization, creates KuksaChannel, and processes authorization via processor.

methods.name: authChecker
methods.description: Retrieves KuksaChannel for a session based on server context metadata.

methods.name: getKuksaChannelForSubscriptionContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves KuksaChannel for subscription based on server context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles gRPC get requests, retrieves data or metadata, and populates response.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Handles gRPC set requests, updates data values, and populates response.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Manages bidirectional streaming for subscriptions, handling subscribe/unsubscribe requests and cleanup.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Processes authorization requests and responds with success or error.

methods.name: RunServer
methods.description: Configures and starts the gRPC server with optional SSL, registers service, and waits for shutdown.
